# arqus - Arbeitskreis Quantitative Steuerlehre

> > A German academic working group dedicated to quantitative tax research, policy analysis, and empirical taxation studies.

arqus (Arbeitskreis Quantitative Steuerlehre) is a collaborative network of tax researchers and economists focused on advancing quantitative methods in tax analysis and policy. The organization hosts annual conferences, administers research prizes, and maintains a repository of working papers on corporate taxation, tax planning, and tax reform.

## Key Topics

- Quantitative Taxation
- Tax Research
- Corporate Taxation
- Tax Policy
- Empirical Research
- Tax Planning
- Tax Avoidance
- Tax Reform
- Business Taxation
- Working Papers
- Discussion Papers
- Economics
- Germany

## About arqus

- [Arbeitskreis Quantitative Steuerlehre (arqus)](http://arqus.info): Homepage for arqus, a working group on quantitative tax research
- [Arbeitskreis Quantitative Steuerlehre (arqus) - English](http://arqus.info/en_index.php): English homepage for arqus quantitative taxation research group
- [arqus-Mitglieder](http://arqus.info/mitglieder.html): Directory of arqus working group members and academic network

## Events & Recognition

- [arqus-Tagung](http://arqus.info/tagung.html): Annual conference and event information for arqus members
- [PwC-arqus-Preis](http://arqus.info/preis.html): PwC-arqus Prize thesis competition for tax accounting research
